QuestInfo.name: Brook's Paw Stamp
QuestInfo.0: You need paw stamps from the town foxes to be acknowledged as a fox. Go to Brook to take the fourth test.
QuestInfo.1: Brook says that one #o2400206# got mad and called for help. The #o2400207# crew picked on #p3002001# and #p3002004# again. Defeat the #o2400207#s to get Brook's paw stamp.
QuestInfo.2: You passed the test and got Brook's paw stamp of approval.

0.0: Ohh, hello! Your skin looks so pale and sensitive today. You know, we were talking like we do, and we thought it would be lovely to see those #o2400206#s get taught a lesson, don'tcha know! You see, they got rather cross and called in their kin, and started picking on #p3002001# and #p3002004# again! Those poor dears! Can't you do something about it?

yes.0: The #r#o2400207##k crew is even worse than those other chicks. They're a menace! If you can teach some manners to #r60#k of them, I think that'll be enough to keep them quiet for a while. I'll even give you my stamp of approval, don'tcha know!

no.0: You should see #p3002001# and #p3002004# for yourself. Those poor little dears! I'm sure even your frail heart would be moved by their pain. Help them, and you'll earn my paw stamp.

1.0: That'll show those punks! Great work. Here is my paw stamp, don'tcha know.

yes.0: Let's see how many stamps you have so far. One, two, three, four. You just need one more. I think it's time for you to meet #r#p3002000##k. I've heard so much about you two, don'tcha know!\r\n                                                                 #fUI/DialogImage.img/quest/0

default.0: Defeat #r60 #o2400207#s#k and I'll give you my paw stamp. Like this, bam!
